violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Internal condensate shelf of ice machine is not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC removed ice from machine and washed, rinsed, and sanitized all internal surfaces.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Observed interior of all refrigeration units, exterior of chest freezer in back kitchen and shelving near handwashing sink with accumulation of grime and food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC provided thorough, deep cleaning all food non-contact surfaces throughout kitchen during the inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Observed raw chicken stored above raw beef in 1 DR prep cooler and 2 DR UPR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC placed raw chicken below raw beef in both of refrigeration units.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed containers with raw beef stored on the floor in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved raw beef to shelves 6 inches above the floor.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloths in sanitizing solution.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): to elevate box of commercial yogurt in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PIC discarded milk crates and placed commercial yogurt on the shelf.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. (Repeat from 12/4/23 inspection)
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI - EHS hand delivered copy of clean-up instructions, PIC to store instructions with Employee Health agreement forms.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions: pH strips on site, but not chlorine test strips for bleach/chlorine and water.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a chlorine test kit. CDI - PIC ordered chlorine test strips during the inspection. Do not use pH strips for testing sanitizer, it will not produce a valid result for concentration.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls in the dry storage area and warewashing area as well as inside both walk-in coolers are in need of cleaning (Repeat from 12/4/23 inspection).
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
